cases.name: one tilde after a space strikes through, as on GitHub

reference.title: One tilde
reference.becomes: Struck-through text, by GitHub's rule: a tilde after a space never closes it, so `~5 to ~10` stays text. A pair straight after a letter, a digit or a closing bracket, with no space inside, is subscript instead (see Subscript and superscript).

With `tandemMarkdown.syntax.tilde` at `strikethrough` it is struck through.
